text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algerian businessmen suggest direct shipping link between Bahrain and Algeria.
- Bahrain and Britain's Cable and Wireless Plc sign cooperation agreement.
- Labour minister to attend the International Labour Organisation conference opening in Geneva on June 3.
- Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait aims to raise $25 million from a new investment fund it has launched.
- Investcorp SA, the principle financial entity of the Bahrain-based Investcorp, signs a $400 million loan facility.
- National Hotels Company to reduce its capital from 14 million dinars to eight million dinars.
- National Bank of Bahrain sets up an Islamic investment fund with a minimum investment of $10,000.
